notice: Wheels up Thursday morning. Passport, charger, and one item of clothing for Tucker to wear. No excuses.

items.title: Flight out of Gatwick
items.detail: Gatwick to Porto. Get there two hours early and check your terminal on your own booking.

items.title: Land in Porto and pick up the hire cars
items.detail: Drivers, bring your licence. Everyone else, try to look useful.

items.title: Check in to the villas in Melres
items.detail: Sort out rooms. The pools will be cold. Someone will go in anyway.

items.title: Douro River party boat
items.detail: Boards in Vila Nova de Gaia, across the river from Porto. Sunset sailing.
items.address: Av. de Ramos Pinto 710, 4400-161 Vila Nova de Gaia

items.title: Coach pick-up from the villas
items.detail: Late for the coach means you wear tonight's outfit. Rules are rules.

items.title: Quinta do Bomfim vineyard tour and tasting
items.detail: Symington's estate in Pinhão, deep in the Douro valley. Pace yourself. You won't.

items.title: Check out of the villas
items.detail: Leave them how you found them. Roughly.

items.title: Back into Porto and a walking tour
Flight home to Gatwick
items.detail: The main group flies back around 9pm. Check your own booking for the exact time.

villas.name: Quinta dos Moinhos
villas.summary: The big one. 7 bedrooms, pool, a bar in the pool house, BBQ, parking.

villas.name: Douro Charming Chalet
villas.summary: The overflow. 4 bedrooms, pool, BBQ, and a football and basketball court.

packing: One item of clothing for Tucker to wear. He picks his outfit from the pile each day.
Something for Halloween on Saturday night
GHIC or EHIC card and travel insurance details
Phone charger and a European plug adaptor
Swimmers for the pools and Friday's watersports
A proper jacket. Porto in October rains.
Shoes you can walk a city in on Sunday
Driving licence if you're driving a hire car
Paracetamol and rehydration sachets. You'll thank yourself.
rules: Tucker wears whatever he pulls from the pile. Refusing doubles the forfeit.
Drink with your left hand only. Get caught using your right and you finish your drink.
Anyone late for a coach, boat or flight wears the next outfit.
Mentioning work costs you a shot.
Phones stay off the table at dinner. First one to check theirs buys the round.
The stag is never left on his own. Buddy up.
What happens in the Douro stays in the Douro. Except the photos. Those go below.

contacts.name: SNS 24 health line, for anything not an emergency
